purpose: Summarize independently screened external island mechanism bridges without converting partial links, source availability, or within-system replication into a formal cross-system causal fit.

systems.strength: direct per-visit/service and reproductive-dependency evidence with floral response, but cross-year/cross-paper linkage
broad island-mainland visitation and direct autofertility plus reproductive-assurance and floral-transition recurrence, but no matched per-visit pollen function

one source-defined two-island system contains floral morph-state divergence, pollinator-environment contrast, single-visit pollen deposition and controlled reproductive dependence, but effectiveness/dependency are not matched on Dong Island
source-locked visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and source-labeled autonomous breeding treatments in the same island study, but no matched floral-response transition

why_formal_fit_remains_closed: No external system yet supplies all mechanism links at a matched two-sided population/transition unit.
The four systems do not yet supply one compatible mechanism estimand family with source-locked uncertainty across at least two independent clusters.

Nicotiana has cross-year/cross-paper linkage, Caribbean Gesneriaceae lacks matched per-visit pollen function, Cordia lacks Dong-side direct effectiveness and controlled dependency measurements, and Seychelles lacks a matched floral-response transition.
Partial mechanistic recurrence cannot substitute for Issue #91 direct Izu field measurements.
reopen_rule: Reopen external bridge acquisition only when new lawful source-native material can close a named missing link in an existing partial system or provides a candidate matched floral-response, direct effectiveness, and reproductive-dependency transition with compatible uncertainty and hierarchy.
next_decision_gate: Issue #91 first real six-channel field bundle remains the active executable gate; external bridge work is source-triggered rather than an unconstrained search loop.
claim_boundary: Four independent partial bridge systems strengthen the plausibility and generality of the mechanism architecture and reveal alternative mechanisms, but they do not establish a universal island response, a universal dependency coefficient, historical pollinator-loss causation, or a formal cross-system causal model.
